references.name: embankment-place.jpg
references.observed: Ordinary river-side view inspected. Two stepped arched office roof masses, pale square stone cladding, curved dark glass end walls with diagonal structure, tall flanking sloped pylons with round windows, turquoise shallow roof caps and a central cylindrical glazed oriel. Long lateral office ranges have regular windows. River/bridge and foreground trees are independent context.

references.name: station-2014.jpg
references.observed: Ordinary platform-end view inspected. Full lower arched glazed office front with diagonal bracing, round pylon windows, turquoise oriel above the open railway approach, pale lower side blocks and separate platform/stair spaces. Train, copied branding and signage are reference context only. The station is not a solid ground-to-roof box.

references.name: hotel-front-2020.jpg
references.observed: Ordinary 2020 Strand photograph inspected. Long pale yellow-brick historic hotel frontage with stone cornices, lower arched windows, taller middle rectangular windows, paired upper arches, two added attic storeys and a flat stepped roof. Green iron balcony and shallow entrance canopy, glazed corner bays and corner pavilions frame the frontage. Forecourt, separate Eleanor Cross monument and adjacent hotel annex are not claimed as station geometry.

note: Three ordinary pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles suffice for original medium-fi exterior authoring. Exact hidden openings, small roof inventory, surveyed platform grades and current works remain approximate. No bespoke survey or archival research.
